name: Miyoshi (Saitama, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Miyoshi town emblem in green: a winged ring enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Miyoshi, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 6 January 1972.

features.role: Miyoshi town emblem — a winged ring enclosing a stylised character
